title: Roles and recent activity by repo
description: Type a repo to see its permission-holders and their contributions in this repo during the selected period, plus whether each has activity here in that period. Days since active always refers to the latest recorded activity.

columns.label: role
columns.description: The governance role this user holds in this repository.

columns.label: status
columns.description: Whether this user has activity in this repository within the selected period.

columns.label: days since active
columns.description: Days since this user's last activity in this repository.

columns.label: PRs
columns.description: Pull requests opened by this user in this repository within the selected period.

columns.label: reviews
columns.description: Pull request reviews submitted by this user in this repository within the selected period.

columns.label: merges
columns.description: Pull requests merged by this user in this repository within the selected period.

columns.label: issues
columns.description: Issues opened by this user in this repository within the selected period.

columns.label: labels
columns.description: Labels applied by this user in this repository within the selected period.
